title: Seeker v2.0 submission (JSON view of the CSV)
description: The CSV has '# key: value' header lines, then the header row id,infected,score,count,locations. This schema describes the same content as JSON; the CSV is normative (docs/user/SUBMISSION.md).

id.description: a circuit id of the subset, exactly once

score.description: finite; higher means more likely infected; used for AUROC

count.description: bonus: Trojans claimed; 0 iff infected is 0; empty when not answered

locations.description: bigger bonus: released net names, ';' separated in the CSV
